routeHint: Sidebar -> Groups. Stay on the default 'All' tab. Do not filter. This shot is the top of the page.
alt: Groups page showing the organization card, the member's chapter, a Teams section for role groups, and Programs and activities grouped by category, each row with its member count
notes: Member counts: PRODUCT-BUGS #9 is fixed on master 9c4f4bdbd, so UnitMemberCountService computes a LocalCenter's count instead of returning 0. `bin/console app:recalculate-unit-member-counts` was run before this capture (1172 units updated) and replaced the hand-patched branch totals on the three parent chapters (Virginia Beach 124, Richmond 129, Alexandria 95) with their own active members (26, 24, 26). That is the correct behaviour: the branch total belongs to the chapters list, which shows it with a grey (+N) beside it. Re-run the command before any recapture. All 17 sections do not fit in one 1080px frame, and the 'tall' viewport is not an option here: at 1920x2200 the app drops the sidebar and top bar entirely (probe: no [class*=sidebar] element). fullPage is also ineffective because the app scrolls an inner pane, not the window. The Community groups and Private groups sections therefore get their own shot, groups-browse-private. MUST be captured with a cold cache, on its own: flush Redis (docker exec orgo-1-redis redis-cli FLUSHALL) immediately before this single-spec run. Only the first /my-groups response after a flush carries the full GroupCategory objects; every later response serves a cached payload in which category is reduced to an IRI on all but one group, so the coloured category labels (COMMITTEES, INTEREST GROUPS, ...) render blank.

routeHint: Sidebar -> Groups, then scroll to the bottom of the list. Community groups and Private groups are the last two sections (Browse.vue:292,312).
alt: Bottom of the Groups page showing the Community groups section and the Private groups section, each group listed with its member count
notes: Sections are derived from the groups themselves: Community groups = Group + isJoinable + no category; Private groups = Group + !isJoinable + no category (Browse.vue:452-458). Every group previously carried a category, so both sections were empty and never rendered; six groups were un-categorized to populate them. Private groups are also excluded from /my-groups unless the viewer belongs to them (MyGroupsController:29), so the capture user was added to all three. MUST be captured with a cold cache, on its own: flush Redis (docker exec orgo-1-redis redis-cli FLUSHALL) immediately before this single-spec run. Only the first /my-groups response after a flush carries the full GroupCategory objects; every later response serves a cached payload in which category is reduced to an IRI on all but one group, so the coloured category labels (COMMITTEES, INTEREST GROUPS, ...) render blank. Verified: load 1 gave all four labels, loads 2 and 3 gave three empty ones. Running the whole groups.json file at concurrency 3 warms the cache and loses the labels.
